## The Accounting Exodus

The accounting profession is facing an existential workforce crisis. Over 300,000 accountants and auditors left the profession between 2020 and 2025, and the pipeline of new graduates has declined by 17%.

### Why Accountants Are Leaving

| Reason | % Citing | Addressable? |
|---|---|---|
| Compensation below market | 42% | Yes |
| Work-life balance (busy season) | 38% | Partially |
| Better opportunities in finance/tech | 28% | Yes (compete) |
| Burnout from understaffing | 25% | Yes |
| Lack of career growth | 18% | Yes |
| CPA exam difficulty | 15% | Partially |

### The Pipeline Problem

Fewer students are choosing accounting:

- Accounting bachelor's degrees declined 17% from 2016 to 2024
- CPA exam candidates declined 25% over the same period
- MBA and data science programs are attracting would-be accountants
- The 150-hour rule is a significant deterrent (debated in multiple states)

### Compensation Reality

Accounting pay has historically lagged comparable professions:

| Career Path | Starting Salary | 10-Year Salary | Lifetime Earnings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Public Accounting | $58K | $110K | $3.5M |
| Corporate Finance | $65K | $140K | $4.2M |
| Technology (SWE) | $85K | $200K | $6.5M |
| Data Science | $80K | $175K | $5.8M |

### How to Compete

#### For Public Accounting Firms

- Raise starting salaries : The Big Four have increased entry-level pay by 15-20%. Mid-market firms must follow.
- Reduce busy season burden : Implement mandatory time-off periods, cap weekly hours at 55, distribute work more evenly.
- Accelerate partner track : Compress the 12-15 year timeline. Offer equity or profit-sharing earlier.
- Embrace remote work : Audit and tax work can be done remotely. Firms requiring 5-day in-office will lose talent.
- Invest in technology : AI-powered audit tools, automated tax prep, and cloud accounting reduce tedious work.

#### For Corporate Accounting Departments

- Offer accounting premium : Pay 10-15% above general finance roles to attract CPAs.
- Flexible busy seasons : Not every company has December year-end. Highlight your calendar advantage.
- Career development : Sponsor CPA exam costs, study time, and continuing education.
- Modern tools : NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and automation platforms make the work more interesting.

### Alternative Talent Sources

| Source | Viability | Considerations |
|---|---|---|
| Career changers from finance | High | Strong quantitative skills, need accounting-specific training |
| International accountants | High | Credential evaluation, visa sponsorship |
| Bookkeepers upskilling | Medium | Practical experience, need formal education |
| Accounting bootcamps | Emerging | Fast training, variable quality |
| AI-augmented junior roles | High | Technology handles routine work, humans handle judgment |
